title: "Teaching & Service"

## Teaching and capacity building

**Coordinator, Geospatial Modelling for Public Health Applications Workshop** (MAP, 2024 to present)\
An annual workshop on spatial modelling with INLA, now in its third cohort, drawing over 170 applicants and participants from over seven African countries. I also built the reproducible selection pipeline used to choose each cohort. [Visit the training website](https://map-data-engineering.github.io/geospatial-training-website/)

**Instructor, MAP Early Career Researcher Programme**\
Teach data management and functional programming in R in MAP's six-month programme.

**Instructor, AMMnet Hackathon: "Building an Interactive Malaria Dashboard with R Shiny"** (online, July 2026)\
Led a hands-on session for advanced R users on building an interactive malaria dashboard with Shiny and bslib, from reactive inputs and outputs to deployment on shinyapps.io. [Event page](https://www.ammnet.org/seminars/hackathon-building-an-interactive-malaria-dashboard-with-r-shiny)

**Trainer, AMMnet Tanzania "Introduction to R Training"** (October 2026)\
Taught reproducible workflows with R Markdown to about 30 students, lecturers and public health specialists. Received a Certificate of Appreciation.

**Earlier teaching**\
Trained data clerks, data managers and research nurses in database practice (MITU, MUHAS), and lectured in computing at the University of Dar es Salaam.
